name: Devlikk
description: Devlikks were an avian species native to the planet Ord Radama. They had long necks, shoulders covered in green feathers, a small green tail, and oddly-shaped heads. The average lifespan for a Devlikk was about nine to 10 years; most Devlikk succumbed to senility at age 9. The Podracer Wan Sandage was of this species, as was his son Wan Sandage Jr., along with Raido, Sherloo, and Narralla.
